name: status
title: Termius Status
description: Show Termius login state, last cloud sync time, whether the local vault cache is stale, whether the vault password is remembered, and inventory counts. Does not sync. Call this first when you do not know if the user is signed in.

name: login
title: Sign In to Termius
description: Sign in to Termius Cloud. method=email needs username and password (the vault encryption password). method=google returns a URL; after the user pastes termius://app/continue-sso?... call login_complete. Does not pull inventory; hosts/exec will auto-sync after a password is remembered.

otp.description: Authenticator / Authy code if 2FA is on

remember.description: Remember the vault password in the secret store (encrypted local state protected by a passphrase, OS keychain, or a local key). Default true.

name: login_complete
title: Finish Google Sign-In
description: Finish Google SSO. Pass the termius:// callback from login and the vault encryption password (not the Google password).

otp.description: Authenticator / Authy code if 2FA is on

remember.description: Remember the vault password in the secret store (encrypted local state protected by a passphrase, OS keychain, or a local key). Default true.

name: logout
title: Sign Out of Termius
description: Sign out, delete the remembered vault password, and wipe the local inventory.

name: sync
title: Sync Termius Vault
description: Force a pull from Termius Cloud now. hosts and host pull when their cache is older than 600 seconds. Use sync for exec, files, and inventory, or to pass and remember the vault password. Password comes from the password argument, TERMIUS_VAULT_PASSWORD, or the secret store. Returns the new last_synced and the counts.

password.description: Vault password if it is not remembered

remember.description: Remember the supplied password in the secret store. Default true.

name: hosts
title: List Hosts
description: List Termius hosts (id, label, address, group, username). Pulls Termius Cloud when the local cache is older than 600 seconds. If that pull fails, returns the local cache and sets stale to true. Filter with query against label, address, group, or username. Use host for full SSH settings. Use exec to run a command. Use files for SFTP.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring on label, address, group, or username

name: host
title: Host Details
description: One host plus merged SSH settings and an ssh(1) command when representable. Pulls Termius Cloud when the local cache is older than 600 seconds. If that pull fails, returns the local cache and sets stale to true. name is id or label. Does not return passwords or private keys.

name.description: Host numeric id or exact label

name: exec
title: Run SSH Command
description: Run a shell command on a Termius host over SSH. Required: name (host numeric id or exact label from hosts) and command; optional timeout in seconds caps the SSH phase (connect plus run, default 60). Automatic cloud sync precedes this phase and has a separate 120-second limit. On timeout the connection is closed and the result has timed_out true, exit_code null, and the output so far; the remote process may keep running. Uses the username, password, or key from the vault. Auto-pulls a stale vault first (TERMIUS_SYNC_TTL). Returns stdout, stderr, exit_code, and host_key_verification (configured per-endpoint modes, not proof of completed handshakes). Unspecified strict_host_key_check defaults false; explicit inherited true still verifies server keys. Never echo secrets from the output unless the user asked for that command.

name.description: Host numeric id or exact label

timeout.description: Total seconds for connect plus run (default 60)

name: files
title: SFTP Files
description: Manage files on a Termius host over SFTP. Required: name (host numeric id or exact label from hosts) and action; path is required for every action except list (defaults to .). Uses the username, password, or key from the vault. Auto-pulls a stale vault first (TERMIUS_SYNC_TTL). action=list lists a directory; stat shows one path; read returns file content (utf-8 or base64, max 200000 bytes); write uploads inline content (max 200000 bytes); get copies remote -> local_path on this machine; put copies local_path -> remote; get/put stream without a total-file-size cap; mkdir creates a directory (recursive=true creates parents); rm deletes a file or empty dir (recursive=true deletes a tree); rename moves a remote path (needs dest). timeout caps the SSH phase (connect plus transfer, default 60); automatic cloud sync precedes it with a separate 120-second limit; raise it for big get or put. Prefer this over exec for copy and edit. Never echo secrets from file content unless the user asked. host_key_verification reports configured target/jump modes, not completed handshakes. Unspecified strict_host_key_check defaults false; explicit inherited true still verifies server keys.

name.description: Host numeric id or exact label

path.description: Remote path. Default . (login directory) for list

local_path.description: Path on the MCP host filesystem (get and put)

content.description: File text or base64 payload (write, at most 200000 decoded bytes; use put for larger files)

recursive.description: mkdir/write/put create parents; rm deletes a tree. Default false

timeout.description: Total seconds for connect plus transfer (default 60)

name: inventory
title: List Inventory
description: List groups, identities, SSH keys, or snippets. Auto-pulls a stale vault first (TERMIUS_SYNC_TTL). Identities and keys omit secret material. Snippets include the script text.
